title: TRĀYA 2.0 Community Landslide & Slope-Hazard Report Schema (v1)
description: Formal schema for offline-captured citizen and field slope-hazard observations entering TRĀYA's authenticated agency moderation queue (TRAYA-008 / Issue #5). Enforces mandatory client-side EXIF stripping, deterministic PII redaction, strict null-not-0 casualty semantics for unverified reports, and SHA-256 deduplication fingerprinting.

report_id.description: Stable unique identifier for the community/field report (e.g., uat_cr_dolakha_001 or cr_20261123_abc123).

feature_type.description: Strictly fixed to 'hazard_report' until verified and promoted by an authorized agency officer into a canonical landslide_event.v1 record.

captured_at_utc.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the report was captured on-device (including offline IndexedDB capture).

event_date_utc.description: Nullable ISO-8601 UTC date or timestamp of the observed slope failure; MUST be null when unknown.

time_precision.description: Temporal precision of event_date_utc; MUST be 'unknown' whenever event_date_utc is null.

location_source.description: How coordinates were acquired on-device (live GNSS/GPS fix vs. manual map pin placement).

lon.description: WGS84 longitude in decimal degrees within Nepal region bounds.

lat.description: WGS84 latitude in decimal degrees within Nepal region bounds.

district.description: Canonical Nepal district name (77-district lookup); null if unresolved.

province.description: Canonical Nepal province name (7 provinces); null if unresolved.

trigger.description: Observed or suspected physical trigger (e.g., rainfall, earthquake, road_cut, snowmelt, river_undercutting, unknown).

road_blocked.description: Whether an adjacent road or trail corridor is reported blocked; null if unknown.

fatalities.description: Reported fatalities. Strict null-not-0 rule: MUST be null (never 0) on unverified reports; 0 is permitted only after agency verification (verified_promoted).

injuries.description: Reported injuries. Strict null-not-0 rule: MUST be null (never 0) on unverified reports; 0 is permitted only after agency verification (verified_promoted).

description_redacted.description: PII-free narrative description after deterministic redaction of Nepal phone numbers, emails, citizenship/license IDs, and social handles.

photo_attached.description: Whether a field photograph accompanies the submission.

exif_stripped.description: Mandatory privacy invariant confirming all EXIF/XMP/IPTC/GPS metadata was stripped prior to queue ingestion.

dedup_fingerprint.description: Deterministic SHA-256 hex digest computed from quantized coordinates, event date, and normalized trigger for flag-only deduplication.

pii_redaction_applied.description: Mandatory privacy invariant confirming deterministic PII redaction ran on free-text fields.

title.description: Optional concise PII-free English/Latin summary title.

title_ne.description: Optional concise PII-free Nepali (Devanagari) summary title.

municipality_ward.description: Optional local municipality/rural municipality and ward label (e.g., Gaurishankar RM-5).

location_accuracy_m.description: Optional reported GNSS horizontal accuracy in meters when location_source is 'gps'.

photo_sha256.description: Optional SHA-256 hex digest of the EXIF-stripped image bytes when photo_attached is true.

pii_redaction_tags.description: Redaction category tags emitted by redact_pii() during sanitization.

offline_captured.description: True when captured offline into IndexedDB PWA storage prior to deferred upload.

is_uat_fixture.description: True strictly for synthetic exercise/UAT records in pre-MOU sandbox queues.

duplicate_candidates.description: Flag-only candidate matches against existing landslide inventory records (auto_merged is always false).

moderation_history.description: Append-only agency officer moderation audit trail.

promoted_landslide_record.description: Canonical landslide_event.v1 compatible record produced only when moderation_status transitions to 'verified_promoted'.
